THIS MFA IS FILED UNDER SECTION 173(1) OF MV ACT  1988, AGAINST JUDGMENT AND AWARD DTD:27.11.2013 ON  THE FILE OF THE SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND MEMBER  ADDITIONAL MOTOR ACCIDENT CLAIM TRIBUNAL,
 BAILHONGAL, PARTLY ALLOWING THE CLAIM PETITION FOR  -2-  MFA No. 102905 of 2014 COMPENSATION AND SEEKING ENHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION.
 THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT

The claim petition is filed by the claimant for the injuries sustained in the motor vehicle accident which is allowed in part and Rs.7,05,240/- is awarded as compensation under the following heads:
1. Pain and suffering Rs. 50,000/-
2. Towards medicine and hospital Rs. 2,27,840/- charges 3.
Nourishment charges Rs. 10,000/-

4. Attendant and conveyance Rs. 10,000/-
5. Loss of income during treatment Rs. 35,000/- period 6.

Loss of future income Rs. 3,02,400/-
7. Loss of amenities, future Rs. 40,000/- unhappiness.
8. Towards future medical expenses Rs. 30,000/-
2. Interest is awarded at the rate of 6% per annum on Rs.6,75,240/-.
Liability is fixed on the second respondent/insurer of the vehicle.
Claimant is seeking enhancement in this appeal.
Insurer admits the liability and contends that there is no scope for enhancement.
3. Heard Sri. Srinivas B.Naik, learned counsel for the claimant/appellant and Sri.

2 S.V.Yaji, learned counsel for respondent No.2/insurer.
4. The accident which occurred on 07.06.2012 is not in dispute.
The claimant suffered injuries in the accident is also not in dispute.
The claimant was 20 years at the time of the accident.
Claimant claimed that he was earning Rs.12,000/- per month from his employment in Goa.

In the absence of proof relating to the income,
the Tribunal has taken Rs.7,000/- per month as his income.
As far as disability is concerned, the doctor has assessed 60% disability to the right lower limb and to assess future loss of income, the Tribunal has taken 20% as the disability to the whole body.
5. Learned counsel for the appellant would submit that the compensation awarded under each of the head is on lower side.
6. This Court has considered the contentions raised at the Bar.

7. The compensation under the following heads discussed needs enhancement and no modification is required under the remaining heads as the compensation awarded under the remaining heads is just and fair.

This Court is of the view that compensation under the head of pain and suffering, attendant & conveyance and nourishment charges has to be enhanced for the following reasons:
(a) The appellant has suffered following grievous injuries:
(i) Contusion over right parietal region.
(ii) Contusion over right side of chest.
(iii) Muscle deep crush laceration present over dorsal of right forearm.
( iv )
Contusion over right thigh and fracture of middle 1/3rd shaft femur.
(v) Muscle deep crush laceration right extended from knee to ankle.
(vi) Bone Deep crush laceration over right foot and fracture of 2nd and 3rd metatarsal.
(vii) Contusion over abdomen with bleed in right psuas muscle, right pelvis region.
(b) The appellant has suffered 60% disability to the lower limb and 20% disability to the while body.

8. Considering the nature of injuries and disability suffered by the claimant, this Court is of the view that the compensation under the heads 'pain and suffering', 'attendant & conveyance' and Satish S/O Shankar Chavan vs Amareshwara Reddy C S/O Shiva Reddy ... on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/39430348/
3

sentences.text: 'nourishment charges' has to be enhanced by Rs.60,000/- over and above the compensation awarded by the Tribunal under these heads.
9. Appeal is allowed in part.
10. The impugned judgment and award of the Tribunal are modified.
The appellant/claimant is entitled to a total compensation of Rs.7,65,240/- [i.e.Rs.7,05,240 awarded by Tribunal + Rs.60,000 enhanced amount].

The enhanced compensation of Rs.60,000/- shall carry interest at the rate of 6% per annum and the second respondent/insurer shall deposit the compensation before the Tribunal within six weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.
